data.one_liner: Flutter widget for playing YouTube videos via the official IFrame Player API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑to‑use YouTube player with built‑in controls, fullscreen handling, and live‑stream support. It abstracts the IFrame API behind a Flutter widget and controller.
use_when: You need to embed YouTube videos with minimal code
You want built‑in playback UI and gesture support across Android, iOS, macOS and Web
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained custom UI over the IFrame API
You need offline video playback or non‑YouTube sources
strengths: Built‑in controls, live‑stream UI, fullscreen handling
weaknesses: Customization limited compared to using youtube_player_iframe directly
Relies on WebView which may affect performance on low‑end devices

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose video playback for local or network streams, not limited to YouTube

alternatives.name: chewie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Higher‑level wrapper around video_player with customizable UI

alternatives.name: media_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich, cross‑platform media player supporting many formats and advanced controls

data.minimal_example:
final controller = YoutubePlayerController(initialVideoId: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ', flags: const YoutubePlayerFlags(autoPlay: true));
YoutubePlayer(controller: controller, showVideoProgressIndicator: true);
